meta.styleReference: Twilight Parchment Documentary style adapted from Earth 24 Hours & HumanFireShort — zero clock dial, 100% pure code.

palette.usage: 60% deep plum/indigo shadows & atmospheric midtones, 30% warm earth/silhouettes, 10% key light & rim highlights. Zero #000 or #fff.

light.rimLighting: Every hero character & foreground prop computes key-light-facing warm/cool rim edges dynamically from active light origin.
light.castShadows: Dynamic soft ground & wall shadows cast strictly away from active light origin.

shape.language: Organic painterly smooth Bezier silhouettes with articulated character rigs, layered hills/foliage/architecture, and hand-torn parchment subtitle cards
shape.outline: Dynamic rim-lit edge stroke only on light-facing contours (no uniform thick cartoon outlines)

typography.subtitleCard: Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif (deckle-edge parchment card, centered safe zone)
